gloss: to think up; to devise; to come up with

definitions.gloss: to think up; to devise; to come up with
definitions.explanation: To create or produce an idea, plan, or solution through thinking. Emphasizes the emergence of a new idea.

definitions.gloss: to begin to think; to start pondering
definitions.explanation: To start thinking about something. The ～出す suffix marks a sudden or spontaneous onset, unlike ～{始|はじ}める, which simply marks the start of an action. Compare {泣|な}き{出|だ}す (to burst into tears).

examples.english: To come up with a good method.

examples.english: He came up with a new idea.

notes:
A compound verb from ⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧ (to think) + ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to put out / to begin). The two senses correspond to the two meanings of the ～⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ suffix.

THE TWO MEANINGS OF ～{出|だ}す:
- Producing/extracting: {考|かんが}え{出|だ}す (think something up), ⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}す→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧ (recall), ⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (find)
- Beginning: {考|かんが}え{出|だ}す (start thinking), ⟦{泣|な}き{出|だ}す→泣き出す：06343_nakidasu⟧ (start crying), ⟦{走|はし}り{出|だ}す→走り出す：06679_hashiridasu⟧ (start running)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦アイデア→アイデア：10161_aidea⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{考|かんが}え{出|だ}す: to come up with an idea
- ⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{考|かんが}え{出|だ}す: to devise a method
- ⟦{解決策|かいけつさく}→解決策：19395_kaiketsusaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{考|かんが}え{出|だ}す: to think up a solution

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {思|おも}いつく: to hit upon, to come up with — more spontaneous, like a flash of inspiration
- ⟦{発案|はつあん}→発案：16093_hatsuan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to propose, originate — more formal, often used for official proposals
- ⟦{工夫|くふう}する→工夫する：22180_kufuusuru⟧: to devise, to figure out — emphasizes creative problem-solving through trial and effort
